keyPhrases.text: The experience is not to be missed
Clooney achieves a similar spectral, almost cadaverous quality
so old-fashioned it is downright daring
he adds an extra texture of humor to the role
Other actors are not as successful
A bit more of Frank Langella's malevolence from the film is needed

reasoning: Strong positive review with explicit recommendation ('not to be missed'). Praises Clooney's performance, direction, and timely relevance. Some minor criticisms of certain performances, but overall enthusiasm places it solidly in 4/5 territory.
